verses.original: Καὶ ἐκπορευομένου αὐτοῦ ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ λέγει αὐτῷ εἷς τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ Διδάσκαλε ἴδε ποταποὶ λίθοι καὶ ποταπαὶ οἰκοδομαί
verses.transliteration: Kai ekporeuomenou autou ek tou hierou legei autō heis tōn mathētōn autou Didaskale ide potapoi lithoi kai potapai oikodomai
verses.literal: As Jesus was leaving . . . the temple one of His disciples said to Him Teacher look at the magnificent stones and buildings

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Βλέπεις ταύτας τὰς μεγάλας οἰκοδομάς οὐ μὴ ἀφεθῇ ὧδε λίθος ἐπὶ λίθον ὃς οὐ μὴ καταλυθῇ
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous eipen autō Blepeis tautas tas megalas oikodomas ou mē aphethē hōde lithos epi lithon hos ou mē katalythē
verses.literal: Do you see all these great buildings - Jesus replied Not one . . . stone here will be left on another every one will be thrown down

verses.original: Καὶ καθημένου αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν κατέναντι τοῦ ἱεροῦ ἐπηρώτα αὐτὸν κατ’ ἰδίαν Πέτρος καὶ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἰωάννης καὶ Ἀνδρέας
verses.transliteration: Kai kathēmenou autou eis to oros tōn Elaiōn katenanti tou hierou epērōta auton kat’ idian Petros kai Iakōbos kai Iōannēs kai Andreas
verses.literal: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple Peter James John and Andrew asked Him privately

verses.original: Εἰπὸν ἡμῖν πότε ταῦτα ἔσται καὶ τί τὸ σημεῖον ὅταν μέλλῃ ταῦτα συντελεῖσθαι πάντα
verses.transliteration: Eipon hēmin pote tauta estai kai ti to sēmeion hotan mellē tauta synteleisthai panta
verses.literal: Tell us when will these things happen And what will be the sign that they are about to be fulfilled

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἤρξατο λέγειν αὐτοῖς Βλέπετε μή τις ὑμᾶς πλανήσῃ
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous ērxato legein autois Blepete mē tis hymas planēsē
verses.literal: Jesus began by telling them See to it that no one deceives you

verses.original: πολλοὶ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου λέγοντες ὅτι Ἐγώ εἰμι καὶ πολλοὺς πλανήσουσιν
verses.transliteration: polloi eleusontai epi tō onomati mou legontes hoti Egō eimi kai pollous planēsousin
verses.literal: Many will come in My name claiming I am He and will deceive many

verses.original: ὅταν δὲ ἀκούσητε πολέμους καὶ ἀκοὰς πολέμων μὴ θροεῖσθε δεῖ γενέσθαι ἀλλ’ οὔπω τὸ τέλος
verses.transliteration: hotan de akousēte polemous kai akoas polemōn mē throeisthe dei genesthai all’ oupō to telos
verses.literal: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars do not be alarmed These things must happen but the end is still to come

verses.original: ἐγερθήσεται γὰρ ἔθνος ἐπ’ ἔθνος καὶ βασιλεία ἐπὶ βασιλείαν ἔσονται σεισμοὶ κατὰ τόπους ἔσονται λιμοί ἀρχὴ ὠδίνων ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: egerthēsetai gar ethnos ep’ ethnos kai basileia epi basileian esontai seismoi kata topous esontai limoi archē ōdinōn tauta
verses.literal: Nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom There will be earthquakes in various places as well as famines These are the beginning of birth pains

verses.original: Βλέπετε δὲ ὑμεῖς ἑαυτούς παραδώσουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς συνέδρια καὶ εἰς συναγωγὰς δαρήσεσθε καὶ ἐπὶ ἡγεμόνων καὶ βασιλέων σταθήσεσθε ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Blepete de hymeis heautous paradōsousin hymas eis synedria kai eis synagōgas darēsesthe kai epi hēgemonōn kai basileōn stathēsesthe heneken emou eis martyrion autois
verses.literal: So be on your guard . . . You will be delivered over to the councils and beaten in the synagogues On My account . . . you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them

verses.original: καὶ εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη πρῶτον δεῖ κηρυχθῆναι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον
verses.transliteration: kai eis panta ta ethnē prōton dei kērychthēnai to euangelion
verses.literal: And the gospel must first be proclaimed to all the nations

verses.original: καὶ ὅταν ἄγωσιν ὑμᾶς παραδιδόντες μὴ προμεριμνᾶτε τί λαλήσητε ἀλλ’ ὃ ἐὰν δοθῇ ὑμῖν ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ τοῦτο λαλεῖτε οὐ γάρ ἐστε ὑμεῖς οἱ λαλοῦντες ἀλλὰ τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον
verses.transliteration: kai hotan agōsin hymas paradidontes mē promerimnate ti lalēsēte all’ ho ean dothē hymin en ekeinē tē hōra touto laleite ou gar este hymeis hoi lalountes alla to Pneuma to Hagion
verses.literal: But when they arrest you and hand you over do not worry beforehand what to say Instead speak whatever . . . you are given at that time for it will not be . . . you speaking but the Holy Spirit

verses.original: Καὶ παραδώσει ἀδελφὸς ἀδελφὸν εἰς θάνατον καὶ πατὴρ τέκνον καὶ ἐπαναστήσονται τέκνα ἐπὶ γονεῖς καὶ θανατώσουσιν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Kai paradōsei adelphos adelphon eis thanaton kai patēr teknon kai epanastēsontai tekna epi goneis kai thanatōsousin autous
verses.literal: Brother will betray brother to death and a father his child Children will rise against their parents and have them put to death

verses.original: καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου ὁ δὲ ὑπομείνας εἰς τέλος οὗτος σωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: kai esesthe misoumenoi hypo pantōn dia to onoma mou ho de hypomeinas eis telos houtos sōthēsetai
verses.literal: You will be hated by everyone because of My name but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved

verses.original: Ὅταν δὲ ἴδητε τὸ βδέλυγμα τῆς ἐρημώσεως ἑστηκότα ὅπου οὐ δεῖ ὁ ἀναγινώσκων νοείτω τότε οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ φευγέτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὄρη
verses.transliteration: Hotan de idēte to bdelygma tēs erēmōseōs hestēkota hopou ou dei ho anaginōskōn noeitō tote hoi en tē Ioudaia pheugetōsan eis ta orē
verses.literal: So when you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not be (let the reader understand) then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἐπὶ τοῦ δώματος μὴ καταβάτω μηδὲ εἰσελθάτω τι ἆραι ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho de epi tou dōmatos mē katabatō mēde eiselthatō ti arai ek tēs oikias autou
verses.literal: Let no one on the housetop go back inside . . . . . . to retrieve anything from his house

verses.original: καὶ ὁ εἰς τὸν ἀγρὸν μὴ ἐπιστρεψάτω εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω ἆραι τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ho eis ton agron mē epistrepsatō eis ta opisō arai to himation autou
verses.literal: And let no one in the field return for . . . . . . . . . . . . his cloak

verses.original: Οὐαὶ δὲ ταῖς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσαις καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις
verses.transliteration: Ouai de tais en gastri echousais kai tais thēlazousais en ekeinais tais hēmerais
verses.literal: How miserable those days will be for pregnant . . . . . . and nursing mothers

verses.original: προσεύχεσθε δὲ ἵνα μὴ γένηται χειμῶνος
verses.transliteration: proseuchesthe de hina mē genētai cheimōnos
verses.literal: Pray that this will not occur in the winter

verses.original: ἔσονται γὰρ αἱ ἡμέραι ἐκεῖναι θλῖψις οἵα οὐ γέγονεν τοιαύτη ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως ἣν ἔκτισεν ὁ Θεὸς ἕως τοῦ νῦν καὶ οὐ μὴ γένηται
verses.transliteration: esontai gar hai hēmerai ekeinai thlipsis hoia ou gegonen toiautē ap’ archēs ktiseōs hēn ektisen ho Theos heōs tou nyn kai ou mē genētai
verses.literal: For those will be days of tribulation unseen . . . . . . . . . from the beginning of God’s creation . . . . . . . . . . . . until now and never . . . to be seen again

verses.original: καὶ εἰ μὴ ἐκολόβωσεν Κύριος τὰς ἡμέρας οὐκ ἂν ἐσώθη πᾶσα σάρξ ἀλλὰ διὰ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς οὓς ἐξελέξατο ἐκολόβωσεν τὰς ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: kai ei mē ekolobōsen Kyrios tas hēmeras ouk an esōthē pasa sarx alla dia tous eklektous hous exelexato ekolobōsen tas hēmeras
verses.literal: If the Lord had not cut short those days nobody . . . . . . would be saved But for the sake of the elect whom He has chosen He has cut them short . . . . . .

verses.original: Καὶ τότε ἐάν τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ Ἴδε ὧδε ὁ Χριστός Ἴδε ἐκεῖ μὴ πιστεύετε
verses.transliteration: Kai tote ean tis hymin eipē Ide hōde ho Christos Ide ekei mē pisteuete
verses.literal: At that time if anyone says to you Look here is the Christ or ‘There He is do not believe it

verses.original: ἐγερθήσονται γὰρ ψευδόχριστοι καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται καὶ δώσουσιν σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα πρὸς τὸ ἀποπλανᾶν εἰ δυνατὸν τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς
verses.transliteration: egerthēsontai gar pseudochristoi kai pseudoprophētai kai dōsousin sēmeia kai terata pros to apoplanan ei dynaton tous eklektous
verses.literal: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders - to deceive even the elect if that were possible

verses.original: ὑμεῖς δὲ βλέπετε προείρηκα ὑμῖν πάντα
verses.transliteration: hymeis de blepete proeirēka hymin panta
verses.literal: So be on your guard I have told you everything in advance

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις μετὰ τὴν θλῖψιν ἐκείνην Ὁ ἥλιος σκοτισθήσεται Καὶ ἡ σελήνη οὐ δώσει τὸ φέγγος αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Alla en ekeinais tais hēmerais meta tēn thlipsin ekeinēn Ho hēlios skotisthēsetai Kai hē selēnē ou dōsei to phengos autēs
verses.literal: But in those days after that tribulation The sun will be darkened and the moon will not give its light

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ ἀστέρες ἔσονται ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ πίπτοντες Καὶ αἱ δυνάμεις αἱ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς σαλευθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi asteres esontai ek tou ouranou piptontes Kai hai dynameis hai en tois ouranois saleuthēsontai
verses.literal: the stars will fall from the sky and the powers of the heavens will be shaken

verses.original: Καὶ τότε ὄψονται τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐν νεφέλαις μετὰ δυνάμεως πολλῆς καὶ δόξης
verses.transliteration: Kai tote opsontai ton Huion tou anthrōpou erchomenon en nephelais meta dynameōs pollēs kai doxēs
verses.literal: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory

verses.original: καὶ τότε ἀποστελεῖ τοὺς ἀγγέλους καὶ ἐπισυνάξει τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ἀνέμων ἀπ’ ἄκρου γῆς ἕως ἄκρου οὐρανοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai tote apostelei tous angelous kai episynaxei tous eklektous autou ek tōn tessarōn anemōn ap’ akrou gēs heōs akrou ouranou
verses.literal: And . . . He will send out the angels to gather His elect from the four winds from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven

verses.original: Ἀπὸ δὲ τῆς συκῆς μάθετε τὴν παραβολήν ὅταν ἤδη ὁ κλάδος αὐτῆς ἁπαλὸς γένηται καὶ ἐκφύῃ τὰ φύλλα γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγὺς τὸ θέρος ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: Apo de tēs sykēs mathete tēn parabolēn hotan ēdē ho klados autēs hapalos genētai kai ekphyē ta phylla ginōskete hoti engys to theros estin
verses.literal: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree As soon as . . . its branches become tender and sprout leaves you know that summer is near

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ὅταν ἴδητε ταῦτα γινόμενα γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγύς ἐστιν ἐπὶ θύραις
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai hymeis hotan idēte tauta ginomena ginōskete hoti engys estin epi thyrais
verses.literal: So also when you see these things happening know that He is near right at the door

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη μέχρις οὗ ταῦτα πάντα γένηται
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hoti ou mē parelthē hē genea hautē mechris hou tauta panta genētai
verses.literal: Truly I tell you this generation will not pass away until . . . all these things have happened

verses.original: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσονται οἱ δὲ λόγοι μου οὐ μὴ παρελεύσονται
verses.transliteration: ho ouranos kai hē gē pareleusontai hoi de logoi mou ou mē pareleusontai
verses.literal: Heaven and earth will pass away but My words will never pass away

verses.original: Περὶ δὲ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ἢ τῆς ὥρας οὐδεὶς οἶδεν οὐδὲ οἱ ἄγγελοι ἐν οὐρανῷ οὐδὲ ὁ Υἱός εἰ μὴ ὁ Πατήρ
verses.transliteration: Peri de tēs hēmeras ekeinēs ē tēs hōras oudeis oiden oude hoi angeloi en ouranō oude ho Huios ei mē ho Patēr
verses.literal: No one knows about that day or hour not even the angels in heaven nor the Son but only . . . the Father

verses.original: Βλέπετε ἀγρυπνεῖτε οὐκ οἴδατε γὰρ πότε ὁ καιρός ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Blepete agrypneite ouk oidate gar pote ho kairos estin
verses.literal: Be on your guard and stay alert For you do not know when the appointed time will come

verses.original: Ὡς ἄνθρωπος ἀπόδημος ἀφεὶς τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ δοὺς τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐξουσίαν ἑκάστῳ τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ καὶ τῷ θυρωρῷ ἐνετείλατο ἵνα γρηγορῇ
verses.transliteration: Hōs anthrōpos apodēmos apheis tēn oikian autou kai dous tois doulois autou tēn exousian hekastō to ergon autou kai tō thyrōrō eneteilato hina grēgorē
verses.literal: It is like a man going on a journey who left his house put each - servant in charge of his own task and instructed the doorkeeper to keep watch

verses.original: γρηγορεῖτε οὖν οὐκ οἴδατε γὰρ πότε ὁ κύριος τῆς οἰκίας ἔρχεται ἢ ὀψὲ ἢ μεσονύκτιον ἢ ἀλεκτοροφωνίας ἢ πρωΐ
verses.transliteration: grēgoreite oun ouk oidate gar pote ho kyrios tēs oikias erchetai ē opse ē mesonyktion ē alektorophōnias ē prōi
verses.literal: Therefore keep watch because you do not know when the master of the house will return whether in the evening at midnight when the rooster crows or in the morning

verses.original: μὴ ἐλθὼν ἐξαίφνης εὕρῃ ὑμᾶς καθεύδοντας
verses.transliteration: mē elthōn exaiphnēs heurē hymas katheudontas
verses.literal: Otherwise he may arrive without notice and find you sleeping

verses.original: ὃ δὲ ὑμῖν λέγω πᾶσιν λέγω γρηγορεῖτε
verses.transliteration: ho de hymin legō pasin legō grēgoreite
verses.literal: And what I say to you I say to everyone Keep watch
